description: Turns a Jabbertoon move (a block program of kind "behaviour") or a character into a jabbertoon.com link the person can open in their browser. Everything travels inside the link after the #, so nothing is uploaded or stored, by Jabbertoon or by this tool. A move opens in the block editor, where it plays on a character (links.studio adds it to the person's moves in the cartoon studio); a character opens in the cartoon studio (links.create opens it in the character creator). Give exactly one of program, cartoon or character. No link plays a scene or a whole cartoon yet: for a program of kind "scene" or "cartoon", or a cartoon file, the answer is ok false with error code "not_yet" and no link (validate checks one now). A move or a character is checked first: one with errors gets ok false and the errors (as validate gives them) instead of a link.

cartoon.description: A saved cartoon file: {"cast"?, "places"?, "program"}. Links that play one are coming in the next release: the answer is not_yet.

character.description: A character: {"name": "...", "content": {...}}, the content of a character pack (tree, legs, kind, height, footprint, ...), or a whole character pack.

program.description: A move: a block program {"v": 1, "kind": "behaviour", "scripts": [...]}, as get_move returns. A program of kind "scene" or "cartoon" gets not_yet.

name: share_link

code.description: The share code: base64url of the UTF-8 canonical JSON, no padding; the part after #c=.

error_count.description: How many errors the checks found.

errors.description: The errors, in order: the first 50 at most (error_count says how many there are).

link.description: The link to give the person.

links.description: Every page that opens it: blocks, studio, create.

url.description: The jabbertoon.com page the link opens (with not_yet, the page that says what links open today).

warning_count.description: How many warnings the checks found.

warnings.description: The warnings, in order: the first 50 at most (warning_count says how many there are).

title: Make a jabbertoon.com link that opens a move or a character
